feeds.title: New Violinist
feeds.description: Hi there and welcome to New Violinist. My name is Amanda, my team and I are on a mission to give you clear, simplified, and actionable advice about violins, plus unbiased violin reviews. New Violinist was established in 2015 with the goal to provide easy-to-understand violin advice that makes a real impact. I believe in empowering budding musicians with the knowledge to make smarter, more informed choices that impact their future.

feeds.title: Violin Sheet Music Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Heather Figi. I began playing the violin at the age of 4 in a Suzuki Violin program led by Alison Lee Jewer in Janesville, Wisconsin. My biggest passion is to help bring more music into this world and I would love to share my 20+ years of teaching experience with you to help you advance your violin skills, support your young musician(s) and deepen your knowledge of violin pedagogy. In my blog, you will find how to play the violin with expert practice tips, free PDF sheet music downloads, video tutorials & fun violin games to help teach technique.
